title: KCP’s commissions new terminal at Muktyala cement plant
summary: KCP’s commissions new terminal at Muktyala cement plant
body_markdown: **India:** KCP has commissioned a new multi-modal terminal at its Muktyala cement plant in Tamil Nadu following final approval from South Central Railway. The unit is intended to improve logistics infrastructure at the site, improve operational efficiency and reduce freight costs through an improved connection to the railway network. However, the cement producer has also decided to close its packaging plant at Arakkonam in Tamil Nadu due to poor economic conditions and a need to ‘optimise operational costs.’
